scope: Float64 CPU matrix-free Newton directions with dense local preconditioner setup. Capped path passes; cold initialization remains unqualified. Not GPU or physical qualification.
protocol: Audit all38 dense Newton systems on the successful captured-capped projected-continuation trajectory. Preserve dense decisions and endpoint. Matrix-free reduced action uses Hx=J M J^T x+Gx and three independent bilateral Cholesky solves, never dense reduced S in action. Natural-map Jacobian action uses sparse local projection derivatives and normal-dependent radius derivatives. Compare24 seeded Schur actions <=1e-9 normalized, and each Jacobian action against existing assembled D <=1e-9. Preconditioner partitions remaining rows by dynamic articulation-owner tuple (including two-articulation constraints), builds each diagonal D block and pseudoinverts at rcond1e-12. These are CPU dense local preconditioner setups, not GPU code. GMRES restart32/max4cycles/rtol1e-6/atol1e-12, hard160 operator-action limit per system. Require original unpreconditioned relative L2 residual <=1e-6 (absolute <=1e-12 for tiny RHS). No restart/iteration/preconditioner tuning. Record failures; only consider nonlinear replacement if every system passes.
